'''Cutie''' was the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] assigned to the [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing starfighter]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Shea Hublin]] during the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].
